status: DESCRIPTIVE direction proposal only; no executable relational validator or observed fixture verdict

ref.unknown/none: displayId null; no label in semantic ref
ref.known: canonical lowercase UUIDv4; exactly one separately projected label except box
ref.role: derive from semantic ref TYPE; same ID always has the same role

runtime.checking/missing/installing/ready/failed: revision known; reported controller fact, no inferred readiness

modelResult.unknown/none: operationId corresponding unknown/none; blank unknown captured context; outcome/freshness/staleReason/actualProvider unknown
modelResult.pending/running: operationId/model/config known; outcome unknown; captured current or explicitly stale; actualProvider unknown; input/capture setting refs known; actualProvider unknown
modelResult.passed: operationId/model/config known; outcome ok; inspect actualProvider unknown, validate concrete actualProvider; input/capture setting refs known
modelResult.failed: known operation/model/config; inspect outcome invalid-model/operation-failed; validate also runtime-unavailable; inspect actualProvider unknown; input/capture refs known; validate provider unknown unless reported by this invocation
modelResult.cancelled: known operation/model/config; outcome cancelled; inspect actualProvider unknown; input/capture refs known; validate provider unknown unless reported by this invocation
modelResult.fieldScopes: inspectionResult inspect/model-structure; validationResult validate/model-runtime; never copy inspection pass to validation
modelResult.freshness: captured semantic configuration equals current =>current/none; differs =>stale/configuration-changed; projection-only changes preserve it
modelResult.clearPending: new request/config epoch; old completions fenced; no model =>none, known model =>new pending record
modelResult.providerProvenance: private native invocation fact; never preferred/current inference; not proved by serialized concrete provider

preflight.unknown/none: requestId corresponding unknown/none; config/baseModel/dataset unknown; outcome/freshness/staleReason unknown
preflight.pending/running: known request/config/dataset, baseModel known or none, outcome unknown
preflight.passed: same refs; outcome ok; dataset-check only, no model compatibility/readiness proof
preflight.freshness: current config/dataset/baseModel exactly match prospective =>current/none; otherwise stale/configuration-changed preserving outcome

trainingJob.unknown/none: operation/all refs/DeviceRef corresponding unknown/none; outcome unknown
trainingJob.preparing/running/stopping: known job/config; operation-specific refs; outcome unknown
trainingJob.completed: known job/config plus operation refs; outcome ok
trainingJob.cancelled: known job/config plus operation refs; outcome cancelled
trainingJob.failed: known job/config and operation-specific refs; fixed outcome from operationFailures
trainingJob.train: known run/baseModel/dataset/DeviceRef; device projection curated, native choice captured privately
trainingJob.selectedCurrent: ALL fields equal local-training.activeJob; known nonempty operation
trainingJob.selectedHistorical: known terminal completed/cancelled/failed record, same operation matrix; not current readiness

benchmark.unknown: benchmark unknown, captured blank unknown, list empty, counts null, outcome/freshness/staleReason unknown
benchmark.none: benchmark none, captured blank unknown, list empty, counts0, outcome/freshness/staleReason unknown
benchmark.preparing/running/stopping: known benchmark/captured model/config,1..4 distinct providers;0<=successes<=completed<=list length; outcome unknown
benchmark.completed: same known refs; nonempty list; completed=list length; outcome ok iff successes>0, otherwise operation-failed/runtime-unavailable
benchmark.failed: known refs; empty list permitted; counts bounded; outcome invalid-model/runtime-unavailable/operation-failed
benchmark.cancelled: known refs; nonempty list; counts bounded; outcome cancelled
benchmark.freshness: captured semantic configuration equals current =>current/none; differs =>stale/configuration-changed; projection-only changes preserve it
benchmark.zeroSuccessfulPresentation: completed attempts with zero successes display failure; no successful-provider readiness claim

datasetJob.unknown/none: operation/all refs corresponding unknown/none; outcome unknown
datasetJob.failed: known job/config/dataset; fixed outcome from operationFailures
datasetJob.annotate: annotationModel known, including resolved detection fallback at launch
datasetJob.archive: annotationModel none; no model passed to native package invocation

collectionSource.none: unknown/unavailable only; unavailable means no source selected, not observed probe failure
collectionSource.known: any availability; never infer available from permissions

review.datasetUnknown: image unknown; box not known; decision/unsaved unknown
review.datasetNone: image none; box not known; decision/unsaved unknown
review.imageUnknown/None: box not known; decision/unsaved unknown; class/zoom may remain known without action target
review.boxKnown: known dataset/image, known canonical box ID and integer ordinal0..2147483647
review.targetChange: advance selection revision on dataset/image/box/class/decision/unsaved target change; native expected target/revision checked independently

crossCurrent: training-status selected attribution current ==local-training.activeJob in all job fields including state/outcome
Equal IDs never imply equal entity role across unrelated typed refs; compare actual type role

projection.entityLabels: exact known-ref ID/role set excluding boxes; each ID once; no extras; max80
projection.configurationSummaries: exact distinct known complete ModelConfiguration config-ID set; max12
projection.sameCompleteConfiguration: same model/input-subset/capture-subset/preferredProvider semantic facts; separately captured runtime may change revision
projection.renameLocale: projection and sequence only; all group facts, IDs, outcomes, freshness and private operation/selection epochs unchanged
projection.freshness: exact captured/current SEMANTIC configuration, never display labels or summaries
projection.bounds: entire byte/primitive limits include both groups and all projection records

visibility.visibleOrRevealedPanel: protected context strip, reserved200% space, no strip-only hiding/cropping/opacity
visibility.nativeControls: independent and reachable; Reveal/reset/rollback/focus contract preserved
